evidence.assessment: The implementation matches its declared connected ordering <delta A_minus_a(tau) delta A_plus_b(0)>: source occupation times target hole, conjugation on channel a only, and exp(-i*(epsilon_target-epsilon_source)*tau). The reference instead enumerates all eight Fock states, evolves the left operator with many-body energies, and subtracts the product of means; it does not reuse the production Wick contraction.

The finite fixture makes q and -q genuinely different and defines minus operators as channelwise adjoints. A separately ordered full-Fock trace verifies C_minus(-tau).T, not its adjoint, as the reverse product. The consumer sums both branch recipes, indexes minus at the opposite registered time, invokes paired_correlations, and persists both returned keys; neither output is silently dropped. The commutator has no implicit i, hbar, retarded step or force conversion.

The oracle starts with normalized real-space density and complex hopping observables on three cells, checks the unitary Fourier map and directed momentum support, and only then removes the established 1/sqrt(3) from production matrix elements while supplying weight=1/3. Thus normalization is not checked by copying a production weight into another contraction. It uses one explicit spin, exposes an erroneous extra factor two, and checks rectangular source-sector addition and the 4096-transition block boundary. The cited manuscript passages support the finite-volume/unit-cell normalization convention, not identification of these bare gradients with screened phonon vertices.

There is no gap division, cutoff or zero-gap filtering in the primitive. The fixture separately includes a non-diagonal transition between degenerate levels and Gamma diagonal populations; its exact connected Gamma density variance is 13/54. Removing degenerate coherences and removing Gamma populations are distinct exposed mutations, so a positive-gap-only construction cannot pass these comparisons.

Saved status is passed. Exact symbolic reference traces are compared with floating-point production at 0 and +/-pi/2 with tolerance 2e-12; mutation distances must exceed 1e-8. These are inspected saved witnesses, not newly executed checks.

Corrected metadata declares eight finite-BvK cells, the complete 2x2x2 mesh separately for explicit spins 0 and 1, and weight 0.125 per source channel. It agrees with raw source/complete-target FD probabilities separate from quadrature, isolated H0 evolution, Ry energies, tau=t*Ry/hbar, six positive ionic gradients and two dimensionless spin-number Fourier probes. It explicitly inherits only representably nonzero float64 source support without another occupation threshold and keeps complete targets. Gradient-to-force conversion must negate mixed gradient-density entries. Gamma and half are the supplied q sectors, not a full spatial covariance.

The contracts consistently distinguish a grandcanonical quasi-free fermion preparation from Gaussian statistics of bilinear observables. They retain fixed mean N versus exact canonical N, numerical degauss versus a physical temperature, and isolated two-point data versus coupled equilibrium or an irreversible bath. The settled 0007 receipt already records nonzero fourth cumulants and the corresponding exclusions.
